title: Front matter of a lernapps plan file, version 1
description: The YAML front matter of an app's plan file (.vibe/plan.md). The assistant sets archetype and phase; the pre-push hook increments prePushFailures. The review and the evals read all three. Flat: one `key: value` per line. A breaking change gets a new version of this schema.

archetype.description: The kind of app, chosen in Explore from the creator's answers; null until then.

phase.description: The phase the assistant works in now.

prePushFailures.description: Failed runs of the pre-push hook. Written by the hook, never by the assistant.
